predictions.articleTitle: Lithuania vs Liechtenstein Tactical Breakdown & Probabilistic Modeling: Breakthrough Without Kučys?
predictions.coreRecommendation: Lithuania's superior possession structure, Elo baseline, and home rest advantage against a goalless visitor point toward a controlled Home Win / Draw outcome dominated by Under 2.5 goals.
possibilityAssessment: Home Win / Draw: Lithuania's 61.7% possession edge and 51.7% Poisson win baseline favor a narrow 1:0 home victory, while a 0:0 stalemate remains formally covered at 35.9% draw expectancy (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

Under 2.5 Goals: Suppressed combined expectancy (lambda total 1.34) and Liechtenstein's zero-goal Nations League tally concentrate 84.8% of the distribution below three goals (Confidence: High, Value: Moderate)

0:0 Correct Score / Half-Time Draw: Two-thirds of each side's group matches were level at the interval, elevating a goalless stalemate if Lithuania's finishing waste persists (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Can a Kučys-less Lithuania crack Liechtenstein's compact five-match goalless low block?

spf.comment: Covers a patient 1:0 home breakthrough alongside the 0:0 low-block stalemate script, whereas a single call would overlook Lithuania's missing focal striker and recent goalless draw.

over_under.comment: Lambda total of 1.34, Liechtenstein's five-match scoring drought, and Kučys's suspension drive an 84.8% Under 2.5 probability.

score.comment: Both scorelines tie at 26.2% in the Poisson matrix, capturing either a narrow second-half Lithuanian winner or a disciplined visitor clean sheet.

goals.comment: One goal (35.1%) and zero goals (26.2%) represent the two highest-density buckets in a heavily compressed scoring distribution.

bqc.comment: Both teams reached half-time level in two of three group matches, pointing to a 0:0 interval followed by either a late home winner or a full-time stalemate.
